name: interact_uses
verifies: par-interact: sitting on a bench (CP HP regen while seated), mining an ore vein once with a pickaxe, drinking from a water barrel (+10 HP), eating with the motion and the 'attribute = old + n' message, robbing a sleeper
notes: Mining plays the PickOre loop for the 10 s _AI_Action command time (5 strikes, ~11 s; fix-139). GO_Mining and 'Максимум здоровья = n + 2' messages are on the HUD (check the shot / Editor.log). Robbing: put a sleeping human in front of the hero at night (time 2), 'perk Perk_MasterThief', 'sneak', 'rob <npc>'. The treasure spot (give It_Shovel, use obj:G3_Object_Interact_Treasure_Spot_01) opens the loot page and is checked by hand.
